source_family: W_H = original complete H_(p,q), p=3H+4, q=12H+32, H any positive integer
initial_pair: Both complete right vines on every rank1,...,N; empty reaching prefix
period: Access N,...,1, KEEP exactly at N+1-2^j for0<=j<=p, DELETE elsewhere
closure: The actual adjacent A sweeps close A. Counted increasing/decreasing KEEP restoration closes both full trees. All ranks are genuine; source valid for every p,q.
bank_demand_relaxation: Only original RR doubles at critical phases j>=4 cost one; every other original B step costs zero in the accounting diagnostic. Original algorithm, full Q_B and all predicates remain unchanged. These charged RR IDs are genuine original U_int.
coarse_bound: After base phase3 take uniform upper bounds a=b=H on old spine and old left-root banks. Burn 3H+1 RR steps per coarsening interior. At stationary upper carry, 2a_new+b_new <=2a+b-1.
windows: Initial l=1,u=2^(p-3)*(q+1)-3; next l=ceil((l+2)/2)+1<=4 and u=floor(u/2)-(3H+1). Uniformly u_r>=2^(p-3-r)*(q+1)-2(3H+1)-3.
forced_failure: By phase p-1=3+3H the interior fresh-input bounds are zero. Phase p has at least3H+1 consecutive valid interior RR steps. At entry its three carry banks contain at most3H credits. No fresh input occurs, so at least one original U demand is unpaid.
scope: All finite integer capacities for this frozen target-first/increasing-order transfer law, even with maximal A/KEEP replenishment and arbitrary initial balances. Not arbitrary redistribution or Universal CD.
